name: Ijebu garri store
schemaNote: See docs/ogun.md 3.7 and docs/design.md S2.5 (the room rules). Room x runs 0 to width. No hazards, no pits, no timer. Shelves are stacked garri sacks and plank shelves. The store keeper sits by the back wall at room x 60 to 100 (look only, no hitbox, never on the walking line). The gift is the Ijebu garri parcel (the same shield as the Lagos parcel).
